name: shenron
description: Find the seven Dragon Balls while you work, summon Shenron (coiled around the window) and make a wish. Also /dragonradar and /dbztheme, the color scheme switch for every DBZ mod.

findRate.title: Dragon Ball find rate
findRate.description: How often a Dragon Ball turns up while tools run: rare (1.5% per tool call, sure by 60), normal (3%, sure by 40), frequent (8%, sure by 15).

ballEscape.title: Dragon Balls fly away
ballEscape.description: A Dragon Ball you don't /grab within 90 seconds flies away. Off: it waits until you grab it.

hintTail.title: Dragon Balls under the prompt
hintTail.description: Show your Dragon Balls (🐉 ●●●●○○○) at the end of the hint line under the prompt.

shenronAnimation.title: Shenron animation
shenronAnimation.description: While Shenron is summoned, his scales shimmer and his eyes glow and blink.
